items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude translation costs for claim documents, even when the report is required under 2.3.3.
Clauses 7.1.8(e) and (f) exclude the provider's working materials and any surcharge billed alongside the excluded translation.

items.description: Robbery compensation for watch and cash
items.rationale: The reported armed robbery away from home is covered under 2.3 and 11.1, subject to the itemisation required by 7.1.10. The Tudor watch is estimated to reach the €2,500 per-item valuables cap and the cash exceeds the €500 cash cap; their €3,000 total is below the €5,000 away-from-home limit, leaving €2,950 after the single €50 deductible.
Clauses 5.2.3 and 7.1.8(b) exclude forwarding and shipping, even when billed on the same statement as covered property compensation.
